content.value: How do you calculate the element address in two-dimensional array? Consider the linear array (15) AA[25:75] and BB[-10:50]
i) Find the number of elements in each array.
ii) Suppose Base(AA) = 300 and ω = 7 words per memory cell for AA. Find the address AA[65] and AA[70].
